normativeSources.title: WebGL OES_standard_derivatives ratified extension
normativeSources.observedContract: Written for WebGL 1.0; the extension macro is defined when enabled; functionality is core and the extension is unavailable in WebGL 2.0.

normativeSources.title: WebGL 2.0 Specification
normativeSources.observedContract: OES_standard_derivatives functionality moved to core in WebGL 2.0; WebGL 2 uses GLSL ES 3.00 shaders.

targetReceipt.head: a354d0d4a9c6a3ac2429e65620428539799b6e90
targetReceipt.currentUse: object-space procedural q, dFdx/dFdy normals, manual footprint gating, and fixed smoothstep thresholds for pores and fissures

limitations: The candidate repository is pinned, but its README example and preprocessor guard target the WebGL 1 extension profile rather than the R8 WebGL2 profile.
The N09 probe uses an analytic repeated circle mask, not the full R8 noise field or brick camera set.
CI SwiftShader evidence is a target-API semantic root, not hardware GPU, mobile, public deployment or user-acceptance evidence.
